meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码改动变成讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要向团队讲解代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn code changes into an explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain code changes to others

howto.what: 将 GitHub 拉取请求（PR）转为代码变更解说视频：读取 PR 的 diff、提交和文件，生成 changelog、功能展示、修复或重构讲解，并逐帧构建视频成片及相关脚本。无网站抓取步骤，仅用 gh 读取代码变更。
howto.when: 当你给出 PR 链接、owner/repo#N，或在已检出的仓库里说“这个 PR”，并要求制作代码变更讲解视频时触发。产品推广、无 PR 的主题解说不适用；不确定时转 /hyperframes。

say.text: 给 owner/repo#456 生成一个修复讲解视频
我在本地仓库，把这个 PR 做成功能展示视频
say.note: 在已检出的仓库中可用“这个 PR”

howto.what_en: Turns a GitHub pull request into a code-change explainer video: it reads the PR's diff, commits, and files via gh, then produces changelog, feature-reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough frames and final video. No website capture.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or say "this PR" in a checked-out repo and ask for a code-change explainer video. Product promos and non-PR topic explainers are excluded; uncertainty routes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into a code-change explainer video: https://github.com/a/b/pull/1
say_en.note: Provide a PR URL to start

say_en.text: Make a fix explainer video for owner/repo#456
say_en.note: Use owner/repo#N to specify the PR

say_en.text: I'm in a local repo; make this PR a feature reveal video
say_en.note: Use "this PR" in a checked-out repo
